goals.description: Provide office visitors with a way to check office opening hours.

source.quote: Build a small public web page so office visitors can check the office opening hours.

responsibilities.description: Read office opening hours on the public web page.

source.quote: office visitors can check the office opening hours.

responsibilities.description: Implement every product requirement and implementation task.

source.quote: The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for implementing every product requirement and every implementation task.
The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for testing every product requirement.
The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for deploying the page.

responsibilities.description: Provide the hosting environment and the domain name.

source.quote: The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for providing the hosting environment and the domain name.

requirements.description: The page must display the fixed text "Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00" to every visitor.

source.quote: The page must display the fixed text "Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00" to every visitor.

requirements.description: Visitors must be able to read the opening hours without signing in.

source.quote: Visitors must be able to read the opening hours without signing in.

requirements.description: The application shall not contain editing, booking, accounts or other features.

source.quote: This version contains only this static information page; it has no editing, booking, accounts or other product features.

requirements.description: The page must use the existing company hosting environment and the existing company domain.

source.quote: The page will use the existing company hosting environment and the existing company domain

resolutions.description: The Full-stack Developer is responsible and accountable for the hosting and domain, utilizing existing company assets.

source.quote: The Full-stack Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for providing the hosting environment and the domain name. The page will use the existing company hosting environment and the existing company domain; no purchase or new infrastructure is in scope.
